item.title: REF 0.4.0
item.description:
• Live meters while a song plays, under the waveforms: loudness (momentary, short-term, integrated, range), peak and RMS with true peak and overs, loudness history, spectrum with the reference's tone curve behind it, scope, and stereo (goniometer, correlation, balance, width per band). The other song's values show as marks in its colour, so flipping A/B is informative.
  • Fold the meters to one line of numbers, or give them their own window for a second screen (⇧⌘M). Reset (⌥⌘R) starts integrated loudness, range and maximums again. Options in Settings › Meters.
  • Playing is lighter on your Mac: with the meters folded, REF now uses less than 0.3.0 did with no meters at all.
